critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4109 lines (up from 3671) - urgently needs to be split into routers (auth, citas, billing, inbox, presupuestos, settings). Violates 700-line guideline severely.

Presupuesto endpoints use `require_staff_or_admin` for GET/POST but DELETE requires admin - reasonable, but consider consistency; also GET /{id}/pdf allows staff which is fine but PDF contains bank info from company settings - review if staff should see that.
PDF generation is synchronous (reportlab) inside async endpoint - consider await run_in_executor for scale.

PresupuestoCreateInput.items is List[dict] (raw dict) with no schema validation - a client can submit items with wrong types (e.g. amount as string) and calculation will fail with TypeError -> 500. Should define an ItemInput pydantic model with concept:str, quantity:int, amount:float and validate.

Item field naming inconsistency: frontend saves 'concept' but backend PresupuestoCreateInput accepts any dict; PDF renders item.get('concept',''). If someone POSTs items with 'description' key (common convention) they save but render as empty concept in PDF. Standardize.
Mailgun PUT accepts masked '********' string; good UX for not overwriting. But if user actually types '********' as their real key it would be swallowed - low risk but worth noting.

Presupuesto numbering has race condition: two concurrent POSTs both read the same last.number and insert duplicate numbers. Use an atomic counter (findOneAndUpdate on a counters collection) to guarantee uniqueness.
delete_presupuesto uses ObjectId(pid) directly - if pid is malformed will raise bson.errors.InvalidId -> 500. Wrap in try/except -> 400/404.
_send_appointment_reminder uses synchronous smtplib inside async loop (send_appointment_reminders awaits DB but calls sync SMTP) - blocks event loop; consider BackgroundTasks or run_in_executor.
send-reminders has no scheduler/cron trigger - relies on manual admin POST. Needs a scheduled task (APScheduler/cron) documented or added.
AdminPresupuestos.js: window.confirm() used for delete instead of a shadcn Dialog - inconsistent UX with rest of app which uses toast+dialog.
AdminPresupuestos.js: catch blocks silently swallow errors (e.g., fetchRecords/toggleExpand) - user gets no feedback on failure.
